Welcome to Notion!
Here are a few quick things you can do to
get started:
Tap anywhere and just start typing. It's
that simple.
Highlight text and use the menu above
your keyboard to change the style.
Tap the + icon above your keyboard to
add content: headings, to-dos, and
more.
Collapse your keyboard, then tap and
hold this line to move content.
Tap the home icon at the bottom left to
see your pages. (We've installed a To
Do List for you - go check it out!)
Keep exploring!
